observations.judgement: Catalogs are now imported per release locale. en.json, zh-CN.json and both Starlight catalogs are byte-identical to HEAD; the loaded catalogs object, client message subsets and plural count outputs are deep-equal.

Same bytes as the former hard-coded English fallback in src/lib/ai-quickstart.mjs. It reads as a natural imperative placeholder, and it matches the surrounding wording: ai.description "describe your task", ai.noScript "replace the task placeholder", and the README "Replace the request placeholder". It renders after "My goal:" in all three SDK prompts.
与原 src/lib/ai-quickstart.mjs 硬编码的中文占位符逐字节相同。放在“我的目标：”下一行，读作提示用户替换的说明，自然清楚；README 的“替换需求占位符”与之一致。ai.noScript 用“任务占位符”，“任务/需求”的差异早已存在，两者都清楚，不是本次引入。“你的”在占位符中指填写人，可读性好，不必删去。

Not rendered. The phrase lists and limits are the same as the regular expressions and limits that scripts/ai-quickstart.mjs previously hard-coded, now plain substrings; every phrase is a verbatim substring of the unchanged template, and all 6 rendered prompts satisfy them (en 166-169 words, zh-CN 515-558 characters). English phrases follow the glossary (namespace, original distribution APKG; "stable namespace and note keys" is the plural joint form of the glossary's "stable note key"). Chinese "公开 API", "持久化", "运行命令", "验证步骤", "原始分发 APKG" are natural and match the glossary. "namespace 和 note key" keeps the English tokens that the glossary renders as 命名空间/稳定笔记键. That wording already existed in the template and in the former regex, and the prior review scored it terminology 4 without opening an issue. Not a new issue; any later glossary alignment of the zh-CN template must update this contract at the same time.

The placeholder now comes from data and the function fails closed when a locale has none. HEAD silently gave every non-zh-CN locale the English placeholder. For en and zh-CN, the empty, whitespace and sample request outputs and the client before/after templates are identical for all SDKs.

The flat HEAD map is now nested under zh-CN, deep-equal (6 pages, 15 historic Chinese heading aliases). legacyAliases returns the same alias object for each of the 68 records (en records get {} as before), and all 62 section anchor mappings plus the generated alias spans are identical. Examples observed in dist include id="生成-apkg" data-section-alias="export-your-first-deck" and id="下一步" data-section-alias="next-tasks".
